Expense Manager Bot

AI agent for receipts and expenses

An Expense Manager Bot collects the week's receipts from your inbox, files them, and logs each one in your expense sheet. The books are clean before review.

Create this Bot freeHow Krafty works

What the Bot does

  1. Searches your inbox for the week's receipts and invoices.
  2. Saves each file to a receipts folder.
  3. Logs vendor, amount, date, and category in your expense sheet.
  4. Flags large or uncategorized expenses.

What waits for you

  • Saving files and writing rows are app writes, so they wait for your approval unless you always allow them.
  • Messages asking teammates to fill in a category wait for your approval.

Reading your apps needs no approval. Anything that writes to them waits for you. How approvals work

Apps and schedule

Apps in the starter prompt
Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets, Slack
When it runs
Every Friday afternoon, as a routine

You connect each app yourself, and the Bot asks for the ones it needs the first time it runs. A site without a connection can be opened in the Bot's browser on its cloud computer. Swap in the apps your team uses.

Starter prompt

Paste this into a new Bot and edit the details to fit your work.

More jobs for a Bot

  • AI agent for performance investigations

    Know what slowed down and why. Logs into observability tools, reads the flamegraphs, and comes back with the hot spots and a short writeup with screenshots.

  • AI agent for bug reproduction

    Hand engineers bugs they can reproduce. Picks up the support thread, clicks the same path in staging, captures the failure, and drops a repro pack with steps and screenshots.

  • AI agent for customer account health

    See risk and expansion before the QBR. Reads usage, CRM, and support signals across your book and ranks the accounts that need attention, with next steps.
